item.title: 19-year-old arrested on suspicion of assaulting Democrats Party activists in Shoham
item.description:
A 19-year-old resident of Hadid was arrested on suspicion of assaulting activists from the Democrats Party during a political event in Shoham.
According to police, the suspect allegedly spat at the activists and struck them with a metal bar and a helmet. Police have opened an investigation, and the suspect is expected to appear in court on Thursday for a hearing on extending his detention.

item.title: IDF eliminates Islamic Jihad and Hamas terrorists in northern Gaza
item.description:
The IDF confirmed that it struck in the Daraj Tuffah area on Monday and eliminated the terrorist Abdullah Munir Mahmoud Harz, a deputy platoon commander in the rocket array of the Islamic Jihad terrorist organization. The terrorist advanced sniper attacks against IDF troops.
In a separate strike on Monday in the Gaza City area, the IDF eliminated the terrorist Muhammad Wael Mustafa Sha'sha'a, a sniper operative in the Daraj Tuffah Battalion of the Hamas terrorist organization's military wing.
Throughout the war, and particularly in recent weeks, the terrorists advanced terror attacks against IDF troops and Israeli civilians and operated to restore the organizations’ military capabilities, in systematic violation of the ceasefire. The terrorists were eliminated to remove the threat.

item.title: Making aliyah, becoming a community
item.description: Celebrating Aliyah means recognizing the faith and determination involved in the move, including the quiet perseverance that continues years after arrival while being thankful for what olim contribute to the Jewish state.

item.title: Hatzibur Haharedi chair responds to Netanyahu: We're running with full force
item.description:
Moti Leitner, chairman of the Hatzibur Haharedi (Haredi Public) Party, announced that his party will not withdraw from the election race despite mounting pressure.
"I am not withdrawing. We are not withdrawing. We are moving forward at full force and building a new political home. The monopoly of Shas and United Torah Judaism is over," he declared.

item.title: Abraham’s journey: then and now
item.description: We should ask ourselves whether we would be able to make a similar journey, for we find ourselves in almost the same position as our forefather Abraham.

item.title: Iranian Parliament Ghalibaf meets with Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei
item.description:
Iranian media report that Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf met with Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei.
According to the reports, the meeting included "a review of the latest developments in the military, economic, and intellectual war waged by the American-Israeli enemy."

item.title: Minister Zohar: Treatment of haredim is like the Inquisition
item.description: Following the detention of dozens of young Chabad Hasidim at Ben Gurion Airport on suspicion of draft evasion, the Culture Minister issued an unusually harsh condemnation of personal sanctions against Torah students.

item.title: Mamdani condemns Lander's detention, claims Israel continues to detain New Yorkers
item.description:
New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani commented on the detention of Democratic congressional candidate Brad Lander during an unauthorized Palestinian Arab olive harvest near the Jewish town of Beitar Illit.
"Today, Brad Lander, rabbis, and other New Yorkers accompanied Palestinian farmers during the olive harvest. For that, they were detained by the Israeli government. Harvesting olives is not illegal. The occupation is," Mamdani wrote.
He stated that he was thankful that Lander was released, but claimed that "other New Yorkers remain detained, and they must be released immediately."
According to Mamdani, "The same Israeli government detaining them has committed a horrific genocide against Palestinians, killing more than 74,000 people over the last few years alone. The detention of these New Yorkers must end. The occupation must end. The genocide must end."

item.title: Eda Haredit: Voting in elections is forbidden
item.description: In a document they published, the hardline haredi leadership reiterated its longstanding opposition to participation in the governing institutions of the State of Israel.

item.title: IDF Chief of Staff: All October 7th terrorists will meet the same fate
item.description: IDF Chief of Staff LTG Eyal Zamir vowed Wednesday at the IDF Officer's Training School graduation to continue pursuing the perpetrators of the October 7th Massacre. Referring to the elimination of a terrorist involved in Shani Louk's murder, Zamir declared: "All those who infiltrated, murdered, and massacred our children and families, and violated our women, will meet the same fate." He also stressed the IDF's readiness for threats on multiple fronts and the importance of preserving its unity and nonpartisan character.

item.description: Dozens of haredi protesters gathered outside the police station in Kfar Saba to protest the arrest of a draft dodger. Demonstrations were also held on Highway 4.
